title: Adventure Of The Dark Holy Hero
paragraphs: “Yuki-chan, put on some clothes!”
Father quickly removed his cape and draped it over the naked Yuki-chan. Sakura-chan was already wearing something light.
Did Fiancée pick out something that suited her? She was making sure it didn’t slip.
“Seriously… Motoyasu, you can’t just brush things off so easily.”
“That’s true. We can’t let just anyone see Yuki-chan’s naked body. Yuki-chan, you need to be careful.”
“Understood!”
And so, we waited for Ren and Itsuki to return.
“Bubuu!”
Keel came running enthusiastically and called out to the sisters. He looked eager.
“Keel-kun, did you get stronger too?”
“Buhi!”
Keel nodded at the sister’s friend’s words. Of course. After all, Kuro-chan was with him.
“Ren, Itsuki, how did things go on your end?”
“Well… if you ask me, it was just a struggle to implement the strengthening methods…”
“The sheer number of them was overwhelming, but once we started applying them, our attack power skyrocketed.”
“It got to the point where I started thinking we should impose some kind of restriction on ourselves.”
Ren responded with a slightly displeased expression. Itsuki seemed to feel the same way.
“It’s like… we got the ultimate gear at the start of the game. Felt like we were using cheat codes to multiply our stats.”
“Since the dragon veins are activated, our levels rise quickly too. There’s no room for skill.”
“When I fired an arrow and the monsters just evaporated, I felt like I was overdoing it.”
“That’s what happens when you master the proper strengthening methods.”

The monsters here give more experience than their level suggests. For the heroes who have mastered twelve types of strengthening, the monsters are just fodder. In that sense, Father is probably in the least advantageous position to feel the effects of the strengthening.
“And to top it off, Kou came over to me and not only helped everyone train but also wiped out the monsters.”
“Kuro did the same thing on my end. He was devouring monsters left and right.”
“Bubububu! Buhi!”
Keel puffed out his chest proudly. Ren placed his hand on Keel’s head, looking slightly annoyed.
“Yeah, you guys managed to hold your own against the monsters. But this isn’t how it’s supposed to be. You need proper training.”
“Bubuu!”
“Right. According to Motoyasu, even at this strength, there are still tough enemies out there.”
“To think I used to believe blindly that relying on just one strengthening method was enough… Looking back now, I can’t help but feel how foolish I was.”
“Bububu!”
“Oh… so Ren, in the latter half, you were holding back to match everyone else?”
“I figured we were already strong enough. So, I switched to weaker weapons to make the fights more challenging.”
“I did the same. Well, just as an experiment. But I don’t hate taking down weaklings with strong weapons either.”
“Yeah, I get that. Some gamers enjoy that too.”

As we were talking, Kou and Kuro-chan emitted light and transformed into their angelic forms. It seems they had been trying to match the timing. Fiancée had prepared in advance and draped a cape over them.
“Hey, hey! Aren’t we going to hunt more monsters? Kou had so much fun!”
Kou clung to Itsuki and voiced his opinion.
“Even though I heard it was Yuki-san and Sakura-san, it was hard to believe… But after watching them transform and talk right in front of me, I have no choice but to believe it.”
Itsuki muttered with a drained expression.
“Hey, hey, hey, Kawasumi, why aren’t you putting more effort into fighting the monsters?”
Oh? This conversation sounds familiar.
“Because putting in full effort every time doesn’t make a difference in the results. There’s no need to go all out every time.”
“Then why did you tell Kou not to fight? Why, why—”
Ah, it’s turning into that familiar interrogation time.
“Ko-Kou? That’s enough, okay?”
When Father warned him, Kou tilted his head.
“Ehh…?”
But he showed no signs of stopping. Itsuki kept glancing at Father or me, clearly hoping one of us would take over.
“Come to think of it, Itsuki, didn’t Filo-tan once point out in the first world that you had a bad habit of holding back and waiting for someone to get into trouble?”
“Please don’t bring that up here. I don’t remember much about that Itsuki from the first world, but now… I just want to experience real combat.”
“Even so, Itsuki, be careful.”
“Ugh… I understand.”
“Why, why~?”
At that moment, Father approached Kou.
“Why are you so curious, Kou?”
“Umm… because I want to know more about Kawasumi.”
“Why do you want to know about Itsuki?”
“Uhh… because I want to get along with Kawasumi.”
“Why do you want to get along?”
“Ugh… is that bad?”
Kou looked troubled as he started thinking.
“It’s not bad. But why?”
Oh, it’s Father’s ‘why’ counter! Most filolials go silent when faced with this.
“I don’t understand why Motoyasu looks at Naofumi like it’s his own problem.”
I’ll ignore Itsuki’s comment.
“Listen, Kou. What I did to you is the same as what you’re doing to Itsuki. So, I get why you’re curious, but you should think about how you ask, okay?”
“Hmm… Got it. Oh, and… I’m really curious about Kawasumi’s fluffiness.”
Kou nodded as if he understood. It’s always the same with Kou.
This time, I’ll make sure Father doesn’t get mad!
“Curious about fluffiness…”
Just as Father’s gaze was about to move toward Itsuki’s lower body—
“Where are you looking?! He means the hair, obviously!”
“Well, I was just wondering if he’s hairier than he looks…”
At that moment, the big sister and her friend approached.
“Are you Kou-chan?”
“Yeah!”
“I’m Rifana, and this is Raphtalia-chan. Do you remember us?”
“Yeah! You petted me before I grew big, so I remember! Pet me again!”
“Okay. But if you change your form now, the cloth you got will tear, so later, okay?”
“Okay!”
Oh? Kou seems to be getting along well with the big sisters. I thought he was only interested in Itsuki.
“Kou kept wanting to go over to Naofumi and the others. I told him to hold back because Sakura was there.”
“I see.”

Now, about Kuro-chan. Kuro-chan chose a hairstyle that makes him look like a girl at first glance. His hair is black… giving off a cool impression. When he’s with Ren, for some reason, they look good together.
“Ren—”
“What is it?”
Ren responded when Kuro-chan called out to him.
“Um, Kuro was thinking after watching your attacks.”
“Hmm? Is there something wrong with my movements? If so, I’ll fix it.”
Ren was ready to correct any flaws pointed out by others. Hmm, Ren has grown a little.
“Umm, Kuro wants to give cool attack names!”
“…Huh?”
“Bubu! Bububuh!”
Keel joined in and said something too.
“Then Kuro’s kick will be… ‘Black Claw Fang,’ and Keel-kun’s thrust will be ‘Roaring Strike.’”
“Buhii! Bububu!”
Keel was so excited that he started bouncing around.
What kind of conversation is this?

“Then, Ren will ride on Kuro’s back, and together they’ll perform powerful attacks. From now on, the thrilling battle record of Kuro and Ren… the ‘Dark Brave Chronicles’ will unfold. And Kuro will earn the title ‘Black Thunder’—”
“W-Wait, wait! What are you even talking about?!”
“Eh? The Chronicles of Ren and Kuro’s adventures~”
“Bububu! Bububuu!”
“Stop it! That’s not cool! What’s with ‘Dark Brave’?!”
“Then how about ‘Shadow Saint’?”
Ren groaned in agony as he clamped his hand over Kuro-chan’s mouth.
Where did ‘Saint’ come from? Also, shouldn’t it be ‘Dark,’ not ‘Shadow’?
“Why do you keep giving out these titles?”
“Um… Kuro heard Ren say, ‘A dark swordsman sounds cool,’ while he was practicing swings when Kuro was sleeping.”
“—!? You heard that?!”

Oh, so Ren was muttering embarrassing lines like that. Well, since he tries to act cool, he must’ve been imagining his ideal self in his head. In the previous loop, he kept it suppressed, but it seems he let it slip while training after we split up.
“Yo! Dark Swordsman!”
Father joined in and called Ren by the title.
“Shadow Saint~”
The big sister’s friend joined in too.
“Shut up!”
Father and the big sister’s friend teased Ren playfully.
“Naofumi, you…”
“Sorry, sorry. I just thought it was too good not to joke about. If you make it a joke, it won’t sting as much, right? And Kuro-chan, take it easy. Your fun might turn into painful memories for Ren.”
“Ehh? Then, can I give Naofumi a title? And Itsuki too?”
Kuro-chan calls Father ‘Nao,’ Itsuki is ‘Itsu,’ I’m ‘Moto,’ and Ren is ‘Ren’…
I’m a little jealous that Ren is the only one being called properly.
